derivation: From 1/x + 1/y = 1/n with positive integers x < y < 2x, rearrange to n(x+y) = xy.
Set d = x - n, so y - n = n^2/d.
flawed_proof.flawed_classification: An integer n admits a solution if and only if n is a prime power.
flawed_proof.flawed_coprime_claim: If gcd(d, n) = 1 then d divides n^2, so every coprime d yields a valid witness.
flawed_proof.flawed_n_minus_one_claim: n - 1 divides n^2 for every n >= 2, so d = n - 1 always gives a solution.
flawed_proof.flawed_n8_witnesses: For n = 8 the valid witnesses are d in {1, 2, 4, 8}.
flawed_proof.flawed_conclusion: Exactly 2022 integers n in [1, 2025] admit a solution.
